audit.why: Level chart and phase side agree Nami wins levels 1-5, contested at 6, Sona edges ahead on 2+ items — matches the sustain-mirror premise where Nami's single-target burst beats Sona's early trickle heal but her stacking auras out-scale late.

Spikes correctly flag level 2 (Nami all-in before Power Chord stacks), level 6 (both ults point-and-click), first item (Nami's E-empowered autos vs Sona's trickle W), and late (Sona's aura stacking + Crescendo range out-sustains).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles, and breakdown.cooldowns names Crescendo, Aqua Prison and R without ever giving a real cooldown number.
audit.why: Sona's combo opens with an auto-attack reset off Power Chord/Hymn of Valor (Q) — that's the real 'E the carry's committed autos' tell, not a restatement of the good-trade line. Hymn of Valor also applies on-hit, so the bad-trade title 'Trade at their item spike politely' needed its own on-hit-itemization content instead of the pasted tradeBad string. Cooldowns field needed the actual numbers: Crescendo 140/120/100s, Nami's Q 12/11/10/9/8s.
audit.corrected: See edits for dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns.

Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Hymn of Valor applies on-hit — her poke scales with attack speed items, so flat armour alone misreads the trade.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Sona Crescendo (140/120/100s): the stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up, and read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison is down 12/11/10/9/8s and answers one disaster per cast. - Spend the 120/110/100s R only on swing moments.
